case_theme: Wind comfort and structural restraint
documented_decision: Two full-height shear walls and a tuned mass damper allow a highly slender residential tower while keeping major views unobstructed.
limitation: Project engineer source; does not independently prove long-term occupant satisfaction or maintenance cost.
editorial_use: Flagship chapters 5 and 15; standalone case profile justified.

case_theme: Wind damping and cantilevered homes
documented_decision: Outriggers connect the core to perimeter columns; a roof-level water slosh damper moderates wind movement while varied cantilevers preserve apartment layouts.
limitation: Project engineer source; maintenance and inspection regime for the damper is not detailed.
editorial_use: Flagship chapter 5; deep dive on tower motion.

case_theme: Hotel and residences sharing one tower
documented_decision: MEP, security, telecommunications, metering, commissioning and modular HVAC were coordinated for hotel, residences and retail with future maintenance and replacement in mind.
limitation: Design-team account, not an operational audit after occupancy.
editorial_use: Flagship chapters 1, 8, 9, 15; standalone case profile justified.

case_theme: Concrete diagrid and full-scale constructability mock-up
documented_decision: A structural concrete diagrid follows the architectural façade, while a rebar mock-up tested congested nodes before repeated construction.
limitation: Project page still describes construction status inconsistently; completion and current operational data require separate verification.
editorial_use: Flagship chapters 5 and 14; standalone case profile justified.

case_theme: Complex façade delivered through integrated modeling
documented_decision: No two slab edges are identical; walking columns and BIM coordination were used to support the rippled façade and rationalize installation.
limitation: Design-team account; does not quantify façade maintenance or replacement complexity.

case_theme: High-strength concrete, hotel pool and wind damping
documented_decision: High-performance concrete, a liquid damping system and structural accommodation of a triple-height hotel pool illustrate the cost of combining views, slenderness and hospitality.
limitation: Project source; exact concrete and damping data should be quoted only with source attribution.

case_theme: Roof-level tuned liquid damping
documented_decision: A tuned liquid damping system addresses lateral motion in a slender luxury residential tower.
limitation: Brief source, little public information on maintenance or actual measured performance.

case_theme: Exoskeleton as architecture, structure and construction method
documented_decision: The concrete exoskeleton combines support and lateral bracing, uses permanent GFRC formwork and leaves interior plates largely column-free.
limitation: Architect source and award context; independent service-life evidence is limited.
editorial_use: Flagship chapters 5, 6 and 7; case profile justified.

case_theme: Acoustic services, heat recovery to pool and integrated home controls
documented_decision: The tower avoids a dedicated technical floor, treats plumbing acoustics, recovers chiller heat for the pool and integrates early home management systems.
limitation: Engineer source; technology support and current controls status require present-day verification.
editorial_use: Flagship chapters 9, 10, 12 and 13; standalone case profile justified.

case_theme: Timber-concrete hybrid residential high-rise
documented_decision: A timber-concrete composite floor was designed for footfall, acoustics, fire, logistics and flexible residential layouts, with a high-performance façade and building systems.
limitation: Not an ultra-prime project in the classic sense; used for performance and material lessons, not luxury branding.
editorial_use: Flagship chapters 6 and 11; material passport deep dive.

case_theme: Generative design tied to measurable performance
documented_decision: Building form was selected against predefined daylight, sunlight, wind comfort and energy performance indicators rather than image alone.
limitation: Project under development or recently completed; long-term operation is not yet established.

case_theme: Deep excavation, monitoring and resilience-based structural design
documented_decision: Five basement levels, drilled shafts, base mat, shoring and adjacent-structure monitoring are combined with viscous damping and resilience-oriented seismic design.
limitation: Seismic and soil conditions differ from Israel; principles transfer, project numbers do not.

case_theme: Damped outriggers for comfort and material efficiency
documented_decision: Sixteen dampers in each tower connect the core and perimeter through a damped-outrigger system to limit wind and seismic motion.
limitation: Cost savings are reported by the project engineer and should not be generalized.

case_theme: Repeated twist with straight service routes
documented_decision: Identical floor plates rotate around a central core, reducing wind and solar loads while keeping MEP routes largely vertical within the core and service zone.
limitation: Architect-led source; operational and façade replacement experience is not supplied.

case_theme: Shape, wind, critical systems and condensate recovery
documented_decision: The stepped Y-shaped tower disrupts wind patterns, integrates critical backup functions, sky-sourced ventilation and condensate recovery.
limitation: Mixed-use benchmark rather than a pure residential case; scale and climate are exceptional.

case_theme: Balcony geometry as view, shade, social space and wind response
documented_decision: Variable balcony slabs shape views and solar protection while creating outdoor living and altering wind behavior around the façade.
limitation: The available source quotes secondary commentary and does not provide maintenance data.

case_theme: Hooded modules for weather-protected balconies
documented_decision: Eight-story façade modules shade balconies and protect residents from wind and rain while producing varied plans.
limitation: Under construction at time of source; no long-term operating record.

case_theme: Bridges as structural and social infrastructure
documented_decision: Prefabricated steel truss bridges support sky gardens and pools, connecting amenities between towers and turning circulation into communal space.
limitation: Architect source; staffing and ongoing maintenance are not detailed.

case_theme: Horizontal stacking as an alternative to isolated towers
documented_decision: Stacked residential blocks form a network of shaded communal, landscape and circulation spaces suited to a tropical environment.
limitation: Source emphasizes concept more than operational data.

case_theme: Separate resident and service cores with layered privacy façade
documented_decision: Primary residential cores and secondary service cores separate staff movement, while privacy screens and a triple-glazed ventilated façade control views and comfort.
limitation: Architect source; service quality, costs and façade maintenance are not independently audited.
editorial_use: Flagship chapters 7, 8 and 10; case profile justified.

case_theme: Low unit density, deep terraces and climate response
documented_decision: One or two apartments per floor, generous terraces and external shading translate privacy and climate into plan and façade decisions.
limitation: Limited technical and operations information in the public source.

case_theme: Twisting mixed-use tower with vertical core and helical perimeter columns
documented_decision: A 60-degree twist is carried by helical perimeter columns around a vertical core, while hotel rooms and residences follow different stacking logics.
limitation: Architect source; building operations and service separation require additional evidence.

case_theme: Landscape treated as common building infrastructure
documented_decision: Vegetation is a shared asset, maintained centrally by specialist gardeners with remote irrigation rather than left to individual owners.
limitation: Designer source; actual operating cost and plant replacement data are not published in full.
editorial_use: Flagship chapters 7 and 15; standalone profile justified.

case_theme: Vehicle lifts as residential circulation
documented_decision: A dedicated automobile lift system transports residents and cars to parking beside residences, forcing unusual safety, traffic and maintenance coordination.
limitation: Marketing source. Use only to describe the declared system, not reliability or superiority.
editorial_use: Flagship chapters 4 and 8; no standalone profile until independent operating data is found.

case_theme: Large hotel-style residential club as an operating program
documented_decision: A multi-floor club combines pools, sports, wellness, dining, wine, events and dedicated staff, illustrating the operational load behind an amenities list.
limitation: Sales source. Useful for program scope, not for proving capacity, service quality or financial sustainability.

case_theme: Custom glazing and façade procurement tied to light, comfort and embodied carbon
documented_decision: The project developed triple-layer glazing for light, heat and glare control and reports lower-carbon aluminium procurement across the façade.
limitation: Developer source; performance data and independent post-occupancy evidence are limited.
editorial_use: Flagship chapters 7, 11 and 14; case profile may be justified after technical documents are secured.

case_theme: Allowing connected towers to move independently
documented_decision: The SkyPark is divided into structural movement zones over three towers, with tuned dampers and full-scale vibration testing for wind and crowd comfort.
limitation: Hospitality benchmark, not residential. Use for movement, pool and operational scale only.

case_theme: Hotel and residences joined and separated through gardens and a pool bridge
documented_decision: A sunken garden separates and connects uses, while a ninth-floor skybridge carries a long pool, deck, bar and lounge between towers.
limitation: Architect and marketing-oriented source; service flows and plant access need technical verification.
